zh-CN.title: 视频资料预览焕新
items: 带影像资料的视频预览不再使用浏览器原生播放器
底部新增简洁的播放控制与可拖动进度条，视觉与网页整体风格保持一致

en.title: Refined video archive preview
items: Video previews with media details no longer rely on the browser's native player
A compact play control and draggable timeline now match the rest of the web experience
